get_x86_backend_config: get the PyTorch x86 backend config for quantization with int8 and float16 dtype support
create_x86_weighted_op_int8_config: create an x86 weighted op DTypeConfig for int8 quantization with quint8 input and qint8 weight
create_x86_dynamic_int8_config: create an x86 dynamic int8 DTypeConfig with quint8 input and float output for dynamic quantization
create_x86_weight_only_config: create an x86 weight-only DTypeConfig supporting quint8 and quint4x2 weight quantization
build_x86_embedding_quantization_config: build x86 embedding quantization config with weight-only quint8 and quint4x2 dtype support
